subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only schema/test fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 be allowed to close this issue, or should registry-derived enum support remain part of this issue’s acceptance criteria?
rationale: The description gap is clear and narrowly fixed by the open PR, but the title includes enum support while the body treats it as optional and a static enum could drift from registered channel/plugin ids.

options.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
options.body: Merge the provider-name description and schema assertion, close this issue, and open a narrower follow-up only if dynamic enum support is still wanted.

options.title: Keep Enum In Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers settle and implement registry-derived enum behavior or explicitly reject it.

options.title: Split The Follow-Up
options.body: Land the linked PR as a partial fix and immediately move enum behavior into a separate product/API follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
recommendation.body: Merge the provider-name description and schema assertion, close this issue, and open a narrower follow-up only if dynamic enum support is still wanted.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history signal on the message-tool schema and outbound channel-selection boundary and already reviewed this issue’s scope.
